item.title: CVE-2026-106027 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Oxygen MyData for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 3.0.9 does not have proper authorisation, nor validate the authenticity of the request, on one of its payment callbacks, allowing unauthenticated users to mark arbitrary WooCommerce orders as completed.

item.title: CVE-2026-110041 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Crop Thumbnails WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not perform object-level authorization when reading and re-cropping media attachments, allowing any authenticated user with the upload capability (the Author role by default) to read the metadata of, and overwrite the generated thumbnail files and stored metadata of, media attachments belonging to other users.

item.title: CVE-2026-110072 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Photo Gallery by 10Web WordPress plugin before 1.8.49 does not escape a shortcode attribute that sets a gallery watermark image before rendering it into an HTML image attribute, and decodes percent-encoded characters in the value, allowing users with Contributor-level access and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting that executes in the browser of any user, including an administrator, who views the published gallery.

item.title: CVE-2026-110959 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Descope WordPress plugin before 1.2.0 does not validate the authentication token it receives before creating a WordPress session, accepting any non-empty token, so an unauthenticated attacker can obtain a session for any existing account, including an administrator, by supplying that account's email address.

item.title: CVE-2026-118421 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.6.3 does not properly sanitise and escape a parameter used to order results on one of its admin screens before using it in a SQL statement, relying on a keyword deny-list whose replacement order can be bypassed, making it possible for users holding the WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.6.3's custom Listing Admin role, and above, to perform SQL injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-118531 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11.1 does not prevent a listing's own author from changing its status from pending to published, allowing users with a Subscriber-level account and above to bypass the administrator's listing moderation and publish their own pending listings.

item.title: CVE-2026-118597 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2 | Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in custom invoice payment terms. An authenticated Manager can save a crafted custom payment-term value. When an authorized user opens Invoice Settings for the same company, Akaunting inserts the stored value into a client-side event-handler expression, causing attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the victim's authenticated origin.

item.title: CVE-2026-119039 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Defender Security WordPress plugin before 6.4.1 does not verify that the client IP address it derives for its firewall and lockout decisions actually originates from a trusted source, trusting a user-supplied value by default, allowing unauthenticated attackers to spoof their IP address and evade IP-based protections such as login lockout and IP banning, impersonate an allowlisted address, and poison the Defender Security WordPress plugin before 6.4.1's activity logs.

item.title: CVE-2026-119040 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Defender Security WordPress plugin before 6.4.1 does not limit the number of failed two-factor authentication attempts in its default configuration, allowing an attacker who already knows a victim's password to brute-force the one-time code and defeat the second authentication factor.

item.title: CVE-2026-121498 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The AskAny WordPress plugin before 2.2.1 does not verify that a chat session belongs to the requester before returning or changing it, allowing unauthenticated users who obtain or guess another visitor's session identifier to read that visitor's chat transcript, name, email address and IP address, and to add messages to their conversation or overwrite their details.

item.title: CVE-2026-122003 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Abilities Bridge WordPress plugin before 1.4.2 does not require a valid nonce before re-authenticating a REST API request from the logged-in session cookie, allowing attackers to make a logged-in administrator perform any REST API action, including creating a new administrator account and taking over the site, by tricking them into opening a crafted page (CSRF).

item.title: CVE-2026-123044 - NVD - CVSS: não informado

item.title: CVE-2026-123092 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP Remote Users Sync WordPress plugin before 2.3.0 does not restrict which user metadata keys may be written through its incoming user synchronisation requests, allowing a site that holds the shared synchronisation keys to set the capabilities of any existing account and escalate it to administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-124647 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The TI WooCommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin before 2.0.7 does not sanitise and escape user input before using it in a SQL statement in a front-end endpoint, allowing unauthenticated users to perform SQL injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-124817 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
